jobs.occupation: Registered Nurse at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Mission in Belgium is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the position of Registered Nurse in the Health Unit.

Jobomschrijving

The jobholder serves as the post’s nurse with responsibilities that include the medical care of Mission employees and eligible family members, utilizing MED approved clinical guidelines, as well as maintenance and inventory of all medical equipment and supplies, implementation of a robust vaccination program, documentation through the global electronic medical record, system administration of group and individual health education programs, and medical emergency contingency planning for the Mission.

EDUCATION: Degree in Nursing (RN level) or Diploma/Certificate equivalent.
EXPERIENCE: 2 years post-qualification clinical work as a professional nurse within the last 10 years.
LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling
jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling.

The Configuration & Marshalling Team Leader ensures effective preparation, coordination, and follow-up of the team's activities in compliance with company standards and procedures. The role involves allocating work according to weekly objectives and priorities set by the Completion Manager, while also actively participating in daily operational activities and supporting the team when required.

Your role:
Reporting to the Completion Manager your main tasks and responsibilities are:
Team Management:

• Lead and coordinate daily team activities
• Identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions
• Allocate resources based on priorities and objectives
• Monitor skills and ensure development plans
• Ensure compliance with quality standards and company rules
• Manage shift handovers

Daily Operations:

• Perform configuration and marshalling tasks
• Act as technical reference
• Train new employees
• Provide operational backup when needed
Communication & Continuous Improvement:

• Report key issues to the Completion Manager
• Communicate effectively within the team
• Contribute to process improvements

Your profile:

• Secondary education or equivalent experience
• Knowledge of aircraft engine components
• Understanding of quality systems and processes
• ERP and IT proficiency
• Team management skills
• Awareness of logistics risks
• Able to manage priorities and urgent issues
• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements
• Working knowledge of French and English required

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: Packing employee
jobs.description:
We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

jobs.occupation: Machine Operator in a Modern Food Production Environment (F/X/M) –
jobs.description:
As a machine operator, you are responsible for keeping our automated production lines running smoothly within the citrus department. You’ll work with various machines such as sorters, weighing, and packaging systems, using MES software to monitor performance. You ensure production is safe, efficient, and meets quality standards.

On a typical workday, you start together with your team of 35 colleagues, distribute tasks, and make sure workstations are set up with the right materials. You instruct colleagues on the line, oversee processes, identify and resolve malfunctions in cooperation with the technical department, and perform minor maintenance. You also carefully register production and control data.

Do you want to grow in a team that uses the latest technologies and values your improvement ideas? Would you like to be part of a department that is constantly developing? Apply now and strengthen our team!

• At least a lower secondary education diploma

• Up to 1 year of experience as an operator or production worker (starters welcome)

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule, with possible three-shift work during busy periods, including weekends

• Detail-oriented, able to follow instructions thoroughly, and aware of quality and safety

• A real team player who can motivate and guide colleagues

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler (m/f/x) for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

jobs.occupation: General Construction Worker F/X/M
jobs.description:
Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

jobs.occupation: Collaborator online exhibition 'History of religious tolerance and peace in Europe'
jobs.description:
• You finalize a web exhibition and an accompanying educational dossier on religious tolerance and peace. 
• You build the exhibition in the online environment developed for this purpose by KADOC (Kirby).
• You will develop and organise activities to involve the heritage sector and the wider public in the launch of the exhibition and the educational dossier.
• You will work with and coordinate with employees within different departments of KADOC and with the researchers involved in RETOPEA.

• You have a passion for history, obtained a master's degree in history, art history or a similar study with a strong historical dimension or equivalent through experience. 
• You are fascinated by religion and diversity, in the past and today. A good knowledge of the religious history of Europe is essential.
• You preferably have experience with the development of public history projects or exhibitions, physically or (preferably) online. 
• You are fascinated by heritage and want to work with it in an educational context. You already have experience in that area or are willing to master it.
• You can work independently but also in a team
• You have experience with accessible writing for a wide audience in Dutch and/or English, and preferably experience with translating complex stories in images and language to a large audience. 
• You are familiar with digital communication channels.

jobs.occupation: Equipment Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.occupation: Shop Assistant - Christmas Store - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a festive retail environment and helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holidays?

For a charming Christmas decoration store in the historic centre of Bruges, we are looking for a full-time Sales Associate who enjoys customer contact and creating a warm shopping experience.

What will you do:

• Welcoming customers and assisting them with their purchases

• Advising customers on Christmas Decorations, ornaments and gifts

• Keeping the store tidy and visually attractive

• Replenishing shelves and displays

• Operating the cash register and handling payments

• Helping with deliveries and unpacking new products

• You speak English and/or Dutch

• Flexible and willing to work weekends

• Previous experience in retail or sales is a plus

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Representative - Spanish & Portuguese Markets
jobs.description:
You play a key role in delivering excellent support and ensuring an efficient order-to-cash process.

Client Details

Our client is an international leader in the life sciences industry, based in Zaventem. They offer a long-term opportunity within their Customer Service team, providing a dynamic international environment, comprehensive training, and strong career development prospects.

Description

As a Customer Service, your key responsibilities are:

• Processing and managing customer purchase orders in a timely manner, ensuring compliance with customer logistics and shipping requirements.
• Serve as the first point of contact for customers, handling inquiries and resolving day-to-day issues.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding orders, products, and services while adhering to company processes and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to manage escalations and ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns.
• Register and track customer issues within Salesforce and ensure appropriate follow-up actions are taken.
• Coordinate closely with Logistics and Warehouse teams to resolve order and delivery-related issues efficiently.
• Support knowledge sharing and participate in market-specific training initiatives.
• Contribute to team performance by maintaining a customer-focused mindset, supporting colleagues, and working towards established KPIs.

We are looking for:

• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, or a related sales administrative role.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, with a good command of Portuguese.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Experience with ERP systems is a plus.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Concrete Mixer
jobs.description:
Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)
